svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Mockup 04: alerts in Discord
svg.text: 04 · Alerts in Discord: one message per incident, edited in place; the fallback; /platform status
Drawn simply as a chat, not Discord's own look. The bot posts as the event's bot; the webhook is the fallback when the bot is down or is the subject.
Use case: the crew in the event's alert channel learns of a problem, acks it with a button, and sees it recover, without opening admin
A · One incident's message, edited in place
No word from it for 2 min. Screen 1 still shows Main hall.
Player Two is on it: "Going to the PC".
Back after 12 min. Nothing more to do.
The @mention is only on the first post, for Down alerts (U3).
B · The channel later: a reminder replies to its incident
4 reconnects in 10 min. Posts and commands are late, not lost.
replying to The bot keeps reconnecting
Nobody has acked yet. 9 reconnects so far.
on it, the bot's token was rotated by mistake
Recovered: the bot is steady again
Back after 45 min. Acked by Player Two at 21:57.
One message per incident; reminders every 30 min as
replies until acked; the recovery is posted even when acked.
C · When the bot is the subject: the webhook; an unknown user
Discord commands and posts are paused.
Sent by the fallback, so no buttons can ack here.
Webhooks take no button clicks: the link opens the incident.
No word from it for 2 min.
Sign in once at the event's admin to act
from Discord. Your Discord account is not a user yet.
D · /platform status: the event's view and the stack's
Down: Main hall screen 2 is dark (6 min, acked)
Only the asker sees it; needs admin.health.read (U16).
Platform alerts live here, never in an event's channel.

Words, never secrets or log lines, travel to Discord (D3). Message caps: at most 10 per audience per 10 min, then a digest (O3). Ack from a button maps the Discord user to a platform user with admin.alerts.ack (U4, D5).
